ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded title: Music Librarianship & Bibliography] LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis; contact Kathy Painter (painter@illinois.edu). Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Required on-campus session Monday, March 3. See section description for 530A at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog. 2 or 4 GR hours; be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit hours. Elective for Graduate Certificate in Special Collections.
